metaDescription: Free online SQL Formatter. Beautify SQL queries.
intro: Use our free online SQL Formatter tool. It beautifies SQL queries based on your inputs.
whatIs: The SQL Formatter is an online utility that beautifies SQL queries. It processes your raw SQL and provides properly indented and capitalized queries.
howToUse: Enter your raw SQL into the designated input field.
Provide any secondary parameters like formatted SQL.
Click the calculate or submit button to generate properly indented and capitalized queries.
Copy or review the resulting output for your needs.
howItWorks: This tool operates in your browser by applying standard algorithms to your raw SQL. It instantly processes the data to output properly indented and capitalized queries.
workedExample: For example: Capitalizes `SELECT` and indents `WHERE` clauses.
resultInterpretation: The result represents properly indented and capitalized queries. You can use this data for your specific calculations or formatting needs.
useCases: Quickly processing raw SQL on the go
tipsAndLimitations: Different SQL dialects (MySQL, Postgres) format slightly differently.
Ensure your inputs are formatted correctly for the best results.
The tool runs completely client-side, ensuring your data remains private.

faq.question: Does it fix syntax errors?
faq.answer: No, it only changes whitespace and capitalization.

faq.question: Is the SQL Formatter free to use?
faq.answer: Yes, our SQL Formatter is completely free and requires no registration.

faq.question: Does this work on mobile devices?
faq.answer: Yes, the tool is fully responsive and functions perfectly on all smartphones and tablets.
